title: Inductive Graph Representation Learning with Quantum Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2503.24111v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (QGNNs) offer a promising approach to combining quantum computing with graph-structured data processing. While classical Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are scalable and robust, existing QGNNs often lack flexibility due to graph-specific quantum circuit designs, limiting their applicability to diverse real-world problems. To address this, we propose a versatile QGNN framework inspired by GraphSAGE, using quantum models as aggregators to generate quantum-native node embeddings. We integrate inductive representation learning techniques with parameterized quantum convolutional and pooling layers, bridging classical and quantum paradigms. The convolutional layer is flexible, allowing tailored designs for specific tasks. translated_title: 基于量子图神经网络的归纳式图表示学习
translated_abstract: 量子图神经网络为将量子计算与图结构数据处理相结合提供了一种有前景的方法。虽然经典图神经网络具有可扩展性和鲁棒性，但现有的量子图神经网络由于采用针对特定图的量子电路设计，往往缺乏灵活性，限制了其在多样化现实问题中的适用性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种受GraphSAGE启发的通用量子图神经网络框架，使用量子模型作为聚合器来生成量子原生的节点嵌入。我们将归纳式表示学习技术与参数化的量子卷积层和池化层相结合，架起了经典范式与量子范式之间的桥梁。该卷积层具有灵活性，允许针对特定任务进行定制化设计。在QM9数据集上的节点回归任务基准测试中，我们的框架在所有聚合步骤中使用单个最小电路，即可处理具有不同原子数的分子，而无需更改电路结构。
tldr: 提出了一种受GraphSAGE启发的通用量子图神经网络框架，通过量子模型作为聚合器生成量子原生节点嵌入，结合归纳式表示学习与参数化量子卷积和池化层，能够仅用单个最小电路处理不同大小的分子图。
en_tdlr: We propose a versatile QGNN framework inspired by GraphSAGE that uses quantum models as aggregators to generate quantum-native node embeddings, integrating inductive representation learning with parameterized quantum convolutional and pooling layers, enabling handling of molecules with varying numbers of atoms using a single minimal circuit.
